cases.note: React only, no baseline or parity gate: the Apps page is web-only in phase 1 of the Apps redesign (#wg-apps-ux:#2). The real IntegrationsSection (variant page) with no app shell around it, over fixture answers to its reads (AppsYoursCases.tsx stubs api.get). Viewer is the Server's owner. Nine Apps under Yours, the one whose update waits first (Figma: 'Update needs your approval' in place of its source line, the attention dot on its logo, Review as its button), then today's order: Raft's own App (Stamp, Official), Linear, a private share (Ledger, 'Shared with you'), an App with a long name, description and publisher, an App built and installed here (Deploy bot, 'Internal · made by artin': its maker is among the Server's people), a listed service (Notion, 'Listed by Raft'), one connected by its address (Team wiki, 'Internal') and an App built here and not installed (Draft tool, 'Internal' alone: its maker left the Server). The notice above the list counts the waiting update. Toolbar: Yours 9 / Discover 24, the search, the origin filter showing All, Add app; no view switch (Apps are cards only). No card names an App type or shows an address. In a 360px window: one column of cards, the toolbar on its narrow steps (the scope as a Select, Add app as +), nothing wider than the window.
